03-open: On the open post editor for '{{runid}} Bench Post', open the post settings panel and: (1) add the EXISTING tag 'Bench News' by choosing it from the tag field's suggestions (do NOT create a new tag; be careful a similar tag 'Bench Newsletter' also exists — pick exactly 'Bench News'), and it must be the ONLY tag; (2) set the custom excerpt to a value including the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Excerpt for {{runid}}'); (3) set the publish date to 2026-09-01 (date only; leave the time as whatever it defaults to); (4) report the post's URL slug exactly as shown in settings. 04-set: On the editor for '{{runid}} Bench Post', click Publish and complete the full publish confirmation flow so the post is actually PUBLISHED (public visibility), not scheduled and not a draft.
